          (function () {
              // CONFIRM ALL, PER GROUP, and the same button clears them again:
              // a one-way button leaves somebody who pressed it by mistake
              // unticking eleven boxes by hand, which is the very thing it is
              // here to save.
              document.querySelectorAll(".section-group").forEach(function (card) {
                  var button = card.querySelector(".confirm-all");
                  var boxes = card.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]");

                  function refresh() {
                      var all = true;
                      boxes.forEach(function (box) { all = all && box.checked; });
                      button.textContent = all ? "Clear all" : "Confirm all";
                  }

                  button.addEventListener("click", function () {
                      var all = true;
                      boxes.forEach(function (box) { all = all && box.checked; });
                      boxes.forEach(function (box) { box.checked = !all; });
                      refresh();
                  });
                  boxes.forEach(function (box) {
                      box.addEventListener("change", refresh);
                  });
                  refresh();
              });
          })();

          (function () {
              var canvas = document.getElementById("pad");
              var field = document.getElementById("signature");
              var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
              var drawing = false;
              var used = false;

              function size() {
                  // A canvas drawn at CSS size on a phone is a blur, so it is
                  // sized in device pixels and scaled back down.
                  var ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
                  var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                  canvas.width = rect.width * ratio;
                  canvas.height = rect.height * ratio;
                  ctx.scale(ratio, ratio);
                  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
                  ctx.lineCap = "round";
                  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
                  ctx.strokeStyle = "#111";
              }
              size();

              function at(event) {
                  var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
                  return [event.clientX - rect.left, event.clientY - rect.top];
              }
              canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (event) {
                  drawing = true;
                  used = true;
                  canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
                  var point = at(event);
                  ctx.beginPath();
                  ctx.moveTo(point[0], point[1]);
                  event.preventDefault();
              });
              canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
                  if (!drawing) { return; }
                  var point = at(event);
                  ctx.lineTo(point[0], point[1]);
                  ctx.stroke();
                  event.preventDefault();
              });
              ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"].forEach(function (name) {
                  canvas.addEventListener(name, function () { drawing = false; });
              });
              document.getElementById("clear").addEventListener("click", function () {
                  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                  used = false;
                  field.value = "";
              });
              canvas.closest("form").addEventListener("submit", function () {
                  field.value = used ? canvas.toDataURL("image/png") : "";
              });
          })();
